### No More Leftovers: A Gift for My God
Author: Jessica Brodie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/no-more-leftovers-a-gift-for-my-god-wholly-loved-october-29.html
Passage: Exodus 23:19
Points:
- Giving back to God is an act of honoring Him as the true owner of everything.
- Treating financial giving like an ordinary bill neglects the joyful heart of a sacrificial offering.
- Scripture calls God's people to bring their first and best resources rather than whatever happens to remain.
- Surrendering firstfruits demonstrates active faith that the Lord will faithfully provide for subsequent needs.

### What Are the 3 Annual Feasts in the Bible?
Author: Emma Danzey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-are-the-3-annual-feasts-in-the-bible.html
Passage: Exodus 23:14-16
Points:
- God established three annual pilgrimage festivals to help His people continually celebrate His redemption and provision.
- The Feast of Unleavened Bread remembered the Exodus and anticipated Christ as the true, sinless Passover Lamb.
- The Feast of Harvest recognized initial agricultural blessings and pointed ahead to the outpouring of the Holy Spirit.
- The Feast of Ingathering looked back on God's shelter in the desert while looking forward to Jesus offering living water.
- Reflecting on these ancient feasts strengthens believers' grasp of Jesus and His completed work of salvation.
